data.exact_reserve_text:
Overall, on an aggregate basis, a reserve release of GBP 5.6m net of reinsurance was made to prior year reserves during 2023 (2022 GBP 8.8m).
The reserve release was primarily due to the favourable development across Property classes partially offset by adverse development on the Legal Indemnities class.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a net prior-year reserve release of GBP 5.6m in 2023, driven mainly by favourable development in Property classes partially offset by adverse development in Legal Indemnities. A gross prior-year movement was not explicitly reported; the report quantifies the movement net of reinsurance.

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit GROSS prior-year movement amount was provided in the notes. The report explicitly states a net prior-year reserve release of GBP 5.6m (net of reinsurance) and comments that this was driven by favourable Property development offset by adverse Legal Indemnities development. A gross PYD figure could not be unambiguously extracted from the gross claims development triangle in the document within the data extraction here; therefore the net figure was used as a fallback and is reported above. A claims development triangle (net and gross) is present (see page 43), but the report gives the explicit quantified prior-year movement only net of reinsurance.
